text:
anya: Quick check — I opened a docs PR that adds a multi-tenant quota example for rate limits and shows how SDK v5 passes quota headers. Can someone glance? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
sam: looked quickly. main nit: the SDK snippet uses `X-Quota-Client` header but our header is `X-RW-Quota-Id` now. if you can switch I'll approve.
maria: also need to mention behavior when tenant hits tenant-level burst credits — docs should explain fallback to account-wide quota. pinged @billing-team for correct wording.
tyler: also dashboard panel link is stale. panel moved from /dashboards/metering to /dashboards/usage. I can update the link.
anya: thanks. I'll switch header name and add a short paragraph for burst fallback. Sam — can you suggest exact wording for header behavior?
sam: copy: 'The X-RW-Quota-Id header identifies the tenant quota bucket. If omitted, requests are billed to the parent account and may be throttled according to account tiers.' feel free to tweak.
alex: small SDK nit — example currently uses `client.setQuota(...)` which we deprecated. Use `client.config({quota: ...})` instead. I'll paste a snippet.
alex: ```js
// v5 SDK
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, config: { quota: { id: 'tenant-123' } } });
await client.generate({ model: 'rw/gpt-3.5', prompt: 'hi' });
```
maria: two more things — add a callout about metrics lag (~5m) on the dashboard and update the sample route to include `region=eu` because metering differs by region.
docs-bot: PR #482 updated: header name replaced, code snippet swapped. CI: lint ok, link-check failed on /dashboards/usage (404).
tyler: I updated the dashboard slug to /dashboards/usage-v2 — docs-bot will need recheck.
anya: pushed changes: swapped header name, used client.config snippet, added paragraph re: burst fallback and metrics lag, changed dashboard link to /dashboards/usage-v2, added region note.
docs-bot: CI re-run: lint ok, link-check ok, netlify preview: https://deploy-preview-482--redwood-docs.netlify.app/examples/multi-tenant-quota preview. :thumbsup:
sam: LGTM. can we add one more tiny example showing how to inspect token-level cost via response metadata? otherwise good to merge.
anya: added a two-line example and merged after approvals. thanks all.
